newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler raises Q4 vehicle output forecast.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler raises Q4 vehicle output forecast.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Wednesday it expects to produce 709,000 vehicles worldwide in the fourth quarter, an increase of 3,500 units from the previous estimate of 705,500.

The change comes from an increase in forecast light truck output. Chrysler said it now expects to make 483,700 pickup trucks, minivans and sport/utilities, up from 479,000 from the previous estimate October 10.
The increase reflects more truck production scheduled in the United States and Canada, and a slight decrease in Austria.
Total car production scheduled in the U.S., Mexico and Canada dropped to 225,300 from 226,500.
A year ago, Chrysler built 699,400 vehicles in the fourth quarter.
